subject: Intake: Finova initial recap, decision threads, and ask list
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@finovahealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + asks from today’s discovery — next steps and MAP ask

Alex — thanks again for the intro call today. Quick recap while the items are fresh: 

What we heard (high level):
- Business outcome: accelerate clinical summarization and internal triage so care coordinators can clear backlog 30% faster.
- Primary constraints: strict PHI handling, data residency in us-east-1, and procurement windows tied to quarter close.
- Decision makers we heard on the call: Maria Lopez (CFO) — economic buyer; Bryan Shaw — security lead; procurement@finovahealth.com for contract and PO.

Key decision criteria you emphasized:
1) Operational latency for summary generation (p95 under 1.2s per request)
2) Per-inference cost at production scale (target <$0.002/token equivalent)
3) Data isolation + SOC2 + on-prem option if needed
4) Clear rollback/SLAs for availability

Immediate asks / what I’ll own:
- I’ll draft a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestone owners and dates and share a Drive copy by EOD tomorrow.
- Attach the RFI template you mentioned — please return with Bryan’s security contact filled where possible. (Attachment: Finova-RFI.xlsx)
- Proposed pilot window: 4–6 weeks; tentative start target Aug 16 to align with your Q3 validation window.

Next meeting: can we lock a 30-min follow-up Aug 2 to review MAP and security gaps? If that works I’ll send a calendar invite.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

---
Note: RFI attached as requested.

From: Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@finovahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@finovahealth.com, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@finovahealth.com>, Bryan Shaw <b.shaw@finovahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 15:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + asks from today’s discovery — next steps and MAP ask

Kimberly — thanks for the summary, that’s perfect. A few clarifications from our side:
- Maria will want an ops-level cost estimate plus a 12-month spend projection before she signs off.
- Bryan requested the security questionnaire (I attached the initial doc he prefers). He’ll also want to validate key management integration and audit log export cadence.
- Procurement asked that any contract draft include standard SLAs and a list of our approved data subprocessors up front.

We like the Aug 16 pilot start idea. Priorities for the pilot: 1) a small shadow run of 100k requests/day, 2) end-to-end audit log verification, 3) a short eval of quantized model quality (we can provide a holdout prompt set).

I’ve attached the security questions pdf and added Bryan in cc. I’ll get Maria for availability on Aug 2 — she’s traveling, so she may delegate initial review to her VP.

Best,
Alex
Head of AI Products | Finova Health
alex.garcia@finovahealth.com

Attachment: security-questions.pdf

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 08 Jul 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: procurement redlines + pilot checklist for Finova

Kimberly — internal note after reading Alex’s reply and the security PDF. Key items to bake into the MAP and pre-demo workstream: 
- Procurement redlines we usually see: termination for convenience, data return/destruction clauses, and a 60–90 day payment SLA request. I’ll pre-draft a short clause set we can share to speed legal review.
- Security: Bryan will ask about HSM/KMS integration. Confirm whether Finova expects customer-managed keys or Redwood-managed keys for the pilot. If they want CMK, schedule our infra lead for a tech sync.
- Pilot acceptance criteria (draft):
  * Functional: 95% of sample prompts return coherent summaries (eval to be provided by Finova)
  * Performance: p95 latency <1.2s; throughput 100k/day; failure rate <0.2%
  * Security: audit log export + encrypted-at-rest with KMS key rotation policy attached

Action items I’ll take: draft procurement clause set; create pilot runbook template; prepare short QC script for model quality checks. Dylan — can you own the runbook and be ready to join the Aug 16 pilot kickoff?

Thanks,
Neha
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@finovahealth.com>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@finovahealth.com>, Bryan Shaw <b.shaw@finovahealth.com>, procurement@finovahealth.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: MAP draft + owners, timeline, and immediate asks (please review)

Team — attaching a short MAP summary below and a Drive link with the editable Mutual Action Plan. Please review and flag any missing owners by EOD Monday. I’ll incorporate comments and send a calendar invite for Aug 2 at 10:00 PT to align on MAP and security checklist.

Mutual Action Plan (short view):
- Milestone 1 (Intake & RFI complete): Owner: Alex; Due: 2027-07-12; Deliverables: Finova completes RFI and security questions.
- Milestone 2 (Pilot runbook & pilot kickoff): Owner: Dylan; Due: 2027-07-29 (runbook), Pilot start: 2027-08-16; Deliverables: runbook, test dataset, audit log config.
- Milestone 3 (Procurement & contract terms): Owner: Procurement (Finova) + Kimberly; Due: 2027-08-05; Deliverables: signed SOW or PO, redline review completed.
- Milestone 4 (Pilot evaluation & exec review): Owner: Maria; Due: 2027-09-03; Deliverables: pilot results, cost projection, exec decision.

Immediate asks for Finova:
1) Return Finova-RFI.xlsx with Bryan’s security contact filled.
2) Confirm who will sign SOW (Maria or delegated VP) and expected PO cadence.
3) Provide the holdout prompt set for quantized model eval by 2027-07-20.

Links and artifacts:
- Editable MAP: https://drive.google.com/finova/Shared/MutualActionPlan
- DocuSign contract stub (for review): https://app.docusign.com/Finova/Agreement/7349

Attachments included: Finova-RFI.xlsx, security-questions.pdf, procurement-terms-redlines.pdf

If everyone can confirm the owners above, I’ll publish the MAP and lock the Aug 16 pilot kickoff calendar invite.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123
